verdict: Afterglow is held with real discipline: one typeface, one accent (ember appears only as light and the fluff underline; the only other chroma on the page is the Google mark in the sheet), a distinctive hooked-h wordmark that carries from nav to app tile to footer bleed, and a two-tone heading system that never breaks two lines at 1440 or 390. It stops just short of 9.5 because the visitor's own most cliche line ('super excited to announce') survives the demo under a 'Why it hits' label, and a few compositions (pricing header, the 11 PM card, the phone hero beam) are a notch less finished than the hero.
to_95: Make the Try demo cut 'super excited to announce that' / 'GM fam' style openers the same way it already cuts 'Excited to share that' in the Founder example, or at minimum relabel the panel when nothing confident was cut: never show 'Why it hits' and 'Keep it. Start free' above a result that still contains a phrase the page itself lists under 'never says'.

Give the pricing header a brand moment in its empty right half at 1440 (for example a single struck, ember-underlined 'trial' or a small sharpened post card), so the section opens with the same visual confidence as the bento.
Soften the phone hero beam so it fades into the app window top instead of ending on a hard horizontal seam, and close the dead lower-left area in the 'Say it at 11 PM' card.

issues.where: Try box result (1440 and 390), typed line 'GM fam, super excited to announce that we just raised $2.4M to literally change how traders journal'
issues.problem: Only 'literally' is cut. The sharpened card still reads 'GM fam, super excited to announce that we just raised $2.4M...', the side label says 'Why it hits', and the CTA says 'Keep it. Start free'. Elsewhere the same page strikes 'Excited to share that' (Founder example) and lists 'excited to announce' as a phrase a client never says. The brand's single promise (the fluff goes) visibly fails on the most common announcement cliche a founder or crypto writer will paste, and the tone of the labels contradicts the hedged copy beneath them.
issues.fix: Treat 'super/so/really excited to announce|share (that)' and greeting openers like 'GM fam,' as confident cuts, consistent with the Founder example, and re-capitalise the remainder ('We just raised $2.4M to change how traders journal.'). Where the engine truly leaves a doubtful phrase in, swap the label 'Why it hits' for 'What changed' and the button for 'Start free' so the voice does not claim a win it did not earn.

issues.where: Pricing header at 1440 ('Sharpening is free. Forever.')
issues.problem: The right half of the header row is empty for roughly 300px of height; it is the one section opener with no product or light moment, so it reads flatter than every section around it.
issues.fix: Place one small Afterglow object right-aligned on the header baseline, such as a struck 'free trial' with the ember underline and the words 'No trial. Free is the plan.', or move the Yearly/Monthly toggle to the right edge on the heading baseline and add the ember top-light to the row.

issues.where: Hero at 390, between the trust line and the app window
issues.problem: The ember beam terminates in a hard straight horizontal edge along the window top, with a pale pink-grey band that reads as a clipped gradient more than as light, in the first screen on a phone.
issues.fix: Mask the beam with a vertical fade over the last 24 to 32px and let 15 to 20 percent of it spill onto the window's top hairline (as the desktop version does at the right corner), keeping the peak colour at #FFAA80 instead of the desaturated pink.

issues.where: 'Say it at 11 PM. Post it at 8:40 AM.' card at 1440
issues.problem: The three step tiles end about 110px above the card floor while the phone runs to the bottom edge, leaving a dark dead zone lower-left where the desk photo is murky and adds nothing.
issues.fix: Vertically distribute the three tiles to the card's full height (or anchor them to the bottom), and raise the photo's exposure slightly in the lower-left crop so the laptop and mug read as a scene.

issues.where: Notebook photo inside the phone post and the result thumbnail (photos.jpg sprite, 800px source shown at ~500px CSS)
issues.problem: On 2x displays the sprite is below native resolution, so the one photographic product moment is slightly soft next to razor-sharp type.
issues.fix: Reduce the rendered sprite width to 400px for those two crops (tighter crop on the notebook and pen), which keeps them at 2x from the existing source.

issues.where: Bento body (previews, voice, 11 PM, replies, results)
issues.problem: The same line, 'i lost $4,000 in march doubling my size to win it back', is the featured post in five consecutive cards. It is a coherent story thread, but by the fourth appearance it reads as one sample reused instead of a living account.
issues.fix: Keep it as the thread for 11 PM, Replies and Results (they are one narrative), and give the voice card's 'three takes' and the Four feeds preview a different heycape line so the account feels like it has more than one post.
